/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pysam, collections, time
fn='pooled.infer.donors.q1.bam'
b=pysam.AlignmentFile(fn,'rb')
c=collections.Counter(); n=0; t=time.time()
for r in b.fetch(until_eof=True):
    cb=r.get_tag('CB', True)
    if cb is not None:
        c[cb]+=1; n+=1
    if n and n%2000000==0: print('n',n,'distinct',len(c),'elapsed',time.time()-t, flush=True)
print('done reads with CB',n,'distinct',len(c),'elapsed',time.time()-t)
print('top counts')
for cb,ct in c.most_common(30): print(ct,cb)
PY"

import pysam, collections
fn='pooled.infer.donors.q1.bam'
b=pysam.AlignmentFile(fn,'rb')
tags=collections.Counter(); vals=collections.defaultdict(set); n=0
for r in b.fetch(until_eof=True):
    for t,v in r.get_tags():
        tags[t]+=1
        if n<200000: vals[t].add((v,type(v).__name__))
    n+=1
    if n>=2000000: break
print('reads',n)
for t,c in tags.most_common(): print(t,c, 'sample', list(vals[t])[:10])

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pysam, collections
fn='pooled.infer.donors.q1.bam'
b=pysam.AlignmentFile(fn,'rb')
bc=collections.Counter(); cb_bc=collections.defaultdict(set); n=0
for r in b.fetch(until_eof=True):
    v=r.get_tag('BC', True)
    if v is not None:
        bc[v]+=1
        cb=r.get_tag('CB', True)
        cb_bc[cb].add(v)
    n+=1
print('reads',n,'distinct BC',len(bc))
for v,c in bc.most_common(): print(c,v)
print('num CB with multiple BC', sum(len(s)>1 for s in cb_bc.values()))
print('num CB with 1 BC', sum(len(s)==1 for s in cb_bc.values()))
# distribution
multi=collections.Counter(len(s) for s in cb_bc.values())
print('CB per numBC', multi)
PY"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pysam, collections
fn='pooled.infer.donors.q1.bam'
b=pysam.AlignmentFile(fn,'rb')
cb_bc=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter); n=0
for r in b.fetch(until_eof=True):
    cb=r.get_tag('CB'); bc=r.get_tag('BC')
    cb_bc[cb][bc]+=1; n+=1
print('cells',len(cb_bc),'reads',n)
# print first 5 cb distributions and totals
for cb,d in list(cb_bc.items())[:10]: print(cb, dict(d), sum(d.values()))
# summary of per-cell per-bc counts
mins=collections.defaultdict(lambda:10**9); maxs=collections.defaultdict(lambda:0)
for cb,d in cb_bc.items():
    for bc,ct in d.items():
        mins[bc]=min(mins[bc],ct); maxs[bc]=max(maxs[bc],ct)
print('perBC min/max')
for bc in sorted(mins): print(bc,mins[bc],maxs[bc])
PY"

bc_run=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
for r in b.fetch(until_eof=True):
    prefix=r.query_name.split(':')[0]
    bc_run[r.get_tag('BC')][prefix]+=1
for bc,d in bc_run.items(): print(bc, dict(d))
